name: prompt-coach
description: Before a vague prompt is sent, suggests a sharper rewrite; you choose: send improved, send yours, or edit the suggestion. Never rewrites silently.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Review prompts before sending (toggle any time with /coach).

model.title: Reviewer model
model.description: A small fast model keeps the delay to about a second.

minChars.title: Skip prompts shorter than
minChars.description: Very short replies (yes, continue, ok…) are never reviewed.
